segments.title: Chương 13: 0013【Cùng bạn Biên trốn học】
segments.content:
Grandma scolded in a low voice, "What did you come back for? Don't make the kid run off again."

Guan Xiaolin said matter-of-factly, "She's my own daughter. Transferring schools is such a big deal, of course I had to come and ask about it."

"You didn't ask sooner, you didn't ask later. What's the use of asking now?" Grandma's tone was very displeased.

Guan Xiaolin put down the gift box without a word.

Grandpa came out with a dish, stood for a moment, hesitated to speak, then turned and went back to the kitchen.

"Aigh, what a sin!"

Grandma sighed and went to knock on the bedroom door. "Guanguan, come out and eat first. They're all your favorite dishes. Your grandpa was busy all morning."

Bian Guanyue's voice came from the bedroom, "You guys go ahead, I'm not hungry yet."

Grandpa brought all the dishes to the table and also walked to the bedroom door, saying, "It's okay if you don't come out, but you should still eat a little. Don't starve yourself and cause stomach problems. How about I fix a plate for you and bring it into the room?"

Bian Guanyue didn't reply again.

After another ten seconds or so, the door was suddenly flung open, and Bian Guanyue headed to the kitchen to get some rice.

Guan Xiaolin wanted to follow, but Grandma quickly held her back.

Grandpa said, "Xiaolin hasn't eaten yet, right? I'll get you a bowl."

Three generations sat down around a dining table.

Bian Guanyue just kept her head down and ate, unwilling to say a single word.

Guan Xiaolin had no appetite to pick up her chopsticks. After a period of silence, she finally couldn't help but speak, "Even strangers greet each other politely when they meet. No matter what, we're still mother and daughter. Can't you say a few words to me?"

Bian Guanyue started eating even faster.

Guan Xiaolin got emotional too, her tone unconsciously rising, "Back then, it was your dad who wanted to latch onto a rich woman. It was your dad who cheated first. He was Chen Shimei, and I was Qin Xianglian. He's the one who caused all of this!"

Bian Guanyue sneered.

"Would Qin Xianglian throw her daughter to Chen Shimei? When other people get divorced, they all fight for custody of their children. And you? The judge awarded you to your mother, but you made all sorts of excuses to refuse."

"I was in the first grade, so young, I snuck onto a train by myself and came back to Longdu alone to see you. I got lost and could only wail. Luckily, a police uncle helped me. And what about you? Without a second thought, you sent me right back to Rongcheng, sent me to live with that stepmother!"

"You hate me so much, why did you even give birth to me?"

By the end, Bian Guanyue was screaming hoarsely.

Knowing she was in the wrong, Guan Xiaolin braced herself and said, "You don't understand. I had my own difficulties."

"What difficulties could you have?"

Bian Guanyue said mockingly, "You pushed me over there for no other reason than to disgust that woman, to use me to create conflict and make them divorce, so you could find a chance to get back together with my dad!"

Guan Xiaolin didn't deny it, because that was exactly what she had planned back then.

"You only ever think about yourself. Did you ever think about me?"

Bian Guanyue questioned, "I was only six when you divorced, and I had to live with a stepmother. Did you ever think my stepmother would abuse me? Did you ever think about how miserable I would be caught between them? You're just like my dad, both selfish people!"

Guan Xiaolin retorted, "I'm selfish? How could I be as selfish as your dad? To save himself twenty years of struggle, he abandoned his wife and daughter to marry a widow! He didn't even care that you were being bullied by your stepmother, he just cared about being a kept man living in a mansion, and tossed you to live in an old house with your grandpa and grandma!"

"Don't mention my grandparents. You have no right!" Bian Guanyue stopped eating, threw down her chopsticks, and went back to her bedroom.

Guan Xiaolin chased after her and held the door, not letting her daughter close it. "I have no right? It was your grandma who arranged the match for me to marry your dad in the first place. If it weren't for them, none of this would have happened. They gave birth to a Chen Shimei, so they should be responsible to the end!"

"Get out, this is my room!" Bian Guanyue roared.

Grandpa and Grandma followed them in.

Grandma pulled on Guan Xiaolin's sleeve. "Forget it. You and Xiao Bian have both started new families. What's the point of dredging up old matters and arguing? You've finally come back for a visit, why must you fight like this? If you have something to say, say it nicely."

Guan Xiaolin said aggrievedly, "I flew from Pengcheng to Rongcheng, then took a bus for several hours to come back. Do you think I want to argue with her? If I didn't care about my daughter, why would I go through all this trouble?"

"Save your crocodile tears." Bian Guanyue said.

Guan Xiaolin grew angrier the more she heard. "Crocodile tears? I'm your mother! I've already pulled strings in Pengcheng and found a good school for you. Who do you think I'm running around begging favors from for?"

"Get out, get out, I don't need you to play the good guy!" Bian Guanyue reached out and pushed her mother away.

Both mother and daughter had stubborn tempers, and by now, their emotions had boiled over.

Guan Xiaolin stubbornly refused to leave, even intentionally squeezing her way in.

Grandpa and Grandma quickly tried to persuade them, but to no avail.

The scene became increasingly chaotic. Guan Xiaolin wasn't as strong as her daughter, and in her panic, she grabbed the coat rack to keep her balance.

With a "clang," the coat rack was pulled over and fell, hitting Guan Xiaolin on the forehead.

Seeing her mother injured, Bian Guanyue felt a pang of remorse, and the force of her pushing lessened considerably.

But Guan Xiaolin took the opportunity to squeeze forward. Holding her forehead, she moved past her daughter and walked toward the bed. Her head was dizzy from the blow, and she tripped on the coat rack that had just fallen.

As she stumbled forward, Guan Xiaolin blindly grabbed onto something.

It was the laptop's power cord.

"Crash!"

The laptop was yanked off the desk and fell.

Bian Guanyue stood frozen on the spot, then lunged over to check the situation.

She ignored her fallen mother, instead frantically picking up the laptop.

The battery had been knocked out.

Bian Guanyue picked up the battery and put it back in, then pressed and held the power button. There was no response, just a black screen.

Tears instantly welled up.

Wiping her tears, Bian Guanyue picked up the laptop, then went to the living room sofa, grabbed her schoolbag, and ran out of the house and downstairs.

Seeing this, Guan Xiaolin was furious. "What kind of daughter is this? Her own mother falls and she doesn't care, she only cares about her computer. In her heart, her own mother is less important than a computer!"

Grandpa, who hadn't said much, now explained, "You know that Guanguan has lived with her grandpa and grandma all these years. But what you don't know is that her grandma passed away three years ago, and her grandpa passed away this year. That's why she transferred back."

"Why didn't you tell me sooner?" Guan Xiaolin complained.

Grandma sighed, "We didn't tell you these things because we were afraid you'd come back and cause trouble. When have you two ever met without arguing? You're already 40, you've been married twice, but you still can't change that terrible temper of yours. That laptop just now, that was a birthday present from Guanguan's grandpa before he passed away."

Upon hearing this, Guan Xiaolin fell silent.

Bian Guanyue walked to the roadside, wiping her tears as she waited for a car.

A taxi pulled up. Bian Guanyue opened the door and got in. "Sir, do you know where I can get a computer fixed?"

"I'm really not sure about that," the taxi driver said.

This wretched Fushi County was very poor. It didn't even have a large shopping mall, nor any specialty stores for digital products.

It didn't even have a single fast-food restaurant!

There were probably places to fix computers, but they were few and far between and hard to find. Even a taxi driver might not know.

"To Number Two Middle School," Bian Guanyue said subconsciously.

The taxi driver slammed on the gas. "Hold on tight!"

In a flash, they arrived outside the school gate. Bian Guanyue paid and got out. She wiped her tears, took a deep breath, and pretended to be nonchalant as she walked onto campus.

She called her grandparents to let them know she was safe, saying she hadn't run off and was already at school.

After hanging up, the more she thought about it, the more wronged she felt, and tears began to fall again.

She pulled up her hood and tightened the drawstrings, leaving only her eyes and nose exposed, as if this could shut her off from the outside world.

With her head down, Bian Guanyue entered the classroom and went straight to her seat. She pressed her forehead against her folded arms, pretending to be asleep on her desk.

Only the occasional shudder of her shoulders revealed that she was crying silently.

After lunch, Zheng Feng walked one stop to wait for his goddess, crouching by the roadside to do his homework in the meantime.

He waited and waited, almost late for class, but his goddess still hadn't appeared.

Another bus came, and Zheng Feng had to grit his teeth and get on. Studying was, after all, more important than romance.

He jumped off the bus and sprinted to the classroom. The moment he entered, he saw the familiar figure.

Walking to his seat and putting down his schoolbag, Zheng Feng thought his goddess was taking a nap. He wanted to speak but didn't dare to disturb her.

Just then, the history teacher, Wang Wenliang, appeared.

With a few minutes left before class officially started, Wang Wenliang sat at the teacher's desk, tapping it and calling out, "Who's on duty? Erase the blackboard!"

Chen Guiliang and Xie Yang stepped into the classroom side by side.

Hearing the teacher's call, Bian Guanyue, who had long stopped crying, sat up and took out her history textbook.

A large patch of her sleeve was soaked with tears.

Chen Guiliang walked over and happened to see her bright red eyes.

Tear-drops still clung to her long eyelashes.

Eyes misty with tears, like a pear blossom in the rain.

Even as a man on his second life, Chen Guiliang was instantly struck by that pitiful sight. He wanted to hold Bian Guanyue in his arms to comfort and protect her.

She was simply a delicate little vixen!

"Do you have any tissues?" Chen Guiliang asked Wang Siyu.

Wang Siyu handed over a box of tissues.

Chen Guiliang took the whole box and stuffed it into Bian Guanyue's desk drawer.

Only then did Wang Siyu notice her tear-reddened eyes. She came over and asked Chen Guiliang, "Was she crying?"

Chen Guiliang nodded lightly.

Zheng Feng also sensed something was wrong and asked directly, "What's wrong?"

"Nothing."

Bian Guanyue pulled out a tissue and quickly wiped her tears dry, then handed the rest of the box back to Wang Siyu. "Do you guys know where I can get a computer fixed?"

Zheng Feng quickly said, "My cousin's computer broke, she took it to the city to get it fixed."

"Thanks." Bian Guanyue lowered her head.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Are you in a hurry?"

"It's alright," Bian Guanyue replied.

"It's alright" meant she was in a hurry.

Chen Guiliang stuffed his own books back into his desk, stood up, and said, "Let's go."

Bian Guanyue was puzzled. "Go where?"

Chen Guiliang said, "To get your computer fixed with you."

"Right now?" Bian Guanyue was a bit stunned.

Zheng Feng said anxiously, "Wait… Chen Guiliang, the only place to fix computers is in the city, and class is about to start. Are you going to go now and skip the whole afternoon of classes?"

Chen Guiliang retorted, "Can't you tell? Bian Guanyue is very anxious."

Zheng Feng was afraid Chen Guiliang would take advantage of the situation. "No matter how anxious, we can't leave now. It's just fixing a computer, you can go on the weekend."

Chen Guiliang couldn't be bothered with him anymore. He said to Bian Guanyue, "Come with me, I'll take you to get your computer fixed!"

Bian Guanyue didn't speak, but she silently picked up her laptop and schoolbag.

Under the astonished gazes of Zheng Feng and Wang Siyu, Chen Guiliang led Bian Guanyue toward the teacher's desk.

"Mr. Wang, I'd like to ask for a leave of absence," Chen Guiliang said.

Wang Wenliang was noncommittal, simply reminding him, "Class starts in two minutes."

Chen Guiliang said, "Classmate Bian Guanyue has something very urgent to attend to."

Wang Wenliang looked at Bian Guanyue's tear-reddened eyes and didn't ask any more questions. "Go on, remember to get a leave slip from your homeroom teacher."

"Thank you, teacher!"

Bian Guanyue bowed.

Zheng Feng was dumbfounded. "They just left like that?"

Wang Siyu even added insult to injury, "You walk Bian Guanyue to and from school every day, but it's not as good as Chen Guiliang skipping one class with her."

That one sentence captured the essence of The Bridges of Madison County. Zheng Feng felt like he'd been cuckolded. He said, utterly depressed, "I'm a good student, I never skip class!"

Wang Siyu smiled, "Girls like bad boys."

It wasn't just them talking. The entire class watched as Chen Guiliang led Bian Guanyue out of the classroom.

Hero Chen is so awesome, skipping class with a beauty!

Xie Yang looked shocked and muttered to himself, "What the hell is going on?"

Li Jun had just arrived at the classroom after playing basketball. Reeking of sweat, he asked what was going on, and after finding out, he slapped his thigh. "I could have skipped class too!"

Guan Zhiqiang chuckled foolishly, "Huo huo."

Chen Guiliang's decision wasn't just about showing attentiveness.

He had long planned to go to the city to discuss a business deal and earn his first pot of gold ahead of schedule. On the way back, he could also stop by his home, visit his grandma, and pick up his tenth and eleventh-grade textbooks.

Killing several birds with one stone.

The two had just walked out of the academic building when the class bell rang.

The school gate was also closed. Chen Guiliang offered a cigarette, "Could you please open the gate?"

The guard took the cigarette but didn't help. "Before school ends, you can only enter, not exit. To leave, you need a leave slip signed by your homeroom teacher."

Bian Guanyue said, "Forget it."

"Come with me." Chen Guiliang turned and walked in another direction.

At this moment, Bian Guanyue felt lost and helpless. As if she had found her pillar of support, she followed closely behind Chen Guiliang.

Soon, they arrived at the faculty housing area.

This area was connected to the academic area, and the school's back gate was also located here.

The back gate was wide open, with no one to stop them.

Good students generally didn't know about this route.

Standing on the roadside, Bian Guanyue suggested, "Let's take a taxi, we can get there and back quickly."

"The roads are all terrible. A taxi won't be much faster than the bus," Chen Guiliang said.

Having finally found a breakthrough to open the beauty's heart, how could Chen Guiliang choose to take a taxi?

Wasn't the slow, bumpy bus ride so much more romantic?

Besides, the ride was over two hours long
